_comment: Tier-2 for febio::active_contraction#1. A `solid mixture` with DELETED gives logged element and node data BIT-IDENTICAL to the same deck with 1,0,00,1,0 written out — that identity is how the silent default is established rather than assumed — and both differ from the shipped z-axis frame. All three runs reach normal termination with exit 0 and no warning. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF). MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 neutralises the L.swap / L.drop edits this fixture uses to turn a correct deck into a broken one, so every deck it builds is the correct one and the pitfall is never triggered. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectation 'active_mat_axis_default=reproduced' is no longer printed and the forbidden token 'not_reproduced' appears. Re-verify with `cd && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/Schreibtisch/open-fem-agent/.venv/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness).
